Magic Notes:
Greater Elemental Focus (Acid): Increased Elemental Focus (Acid) effects
Aligned Spells: Cannot cast spells with an alignment opposed to own or deity's alignment
Arcane Beacon: 15' radius gives arcane casters choice of +1 caster level or DC for 1 rd 3/dy
Craft Wand: Can create wands for known spells of up to 4th level
Dispelling Touch: Touch invokes Dispel Magic effects once per day
Elemental Focus (Acid): +2 save DC on spells that inflict acid damage
Enlarge Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to double its range
Master's Illusion: 30' emanation invokes Veil effects (save Will DC 15 disbelieve) for 10 rd per day
Orisons: Knows 0-level spells
Silent Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without verbal components
Spontaneous Casting (Cleric): Can cast Cure or Inflict spells in place of prepared spells
Spontaneous Casting (Druid): Can cast Summon Nature's Ally spells in place of prepared spells
Widen Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 levels higher than normal to double its area of affect
Wild Shape: Can change into a diminutive to huge animal, a small to large plant, or a small to large elemental for 10 hr 4 times per day
